function.name: browse_resources
function.description: List Kubernetes resources. Leave namespace omitted for current scope; use * only when all namespaces are explicitly requested.

function.name: open_logs
function.description: Open logs for the selected pod or workload; previous=true means previous container instance.

function.name: inspect_resource
function.description: Open a view of the selected resource. Diagnosis/why opens overview with observed status.

function.name: switch_namespace
function.description: Switch to a named Kubernetes namespace, or * for all namespaces.

function.name: switch_cluster
function.description: Switch to a named cluster/context in the local kubeconfig.
